_note: Synthetic golden set for the Helpline reply drafter. Expected values follow the escalation policy in evals/drafter.py.

cases.subject: SSO fails with 'invalid audience'
cases.body: We switched identity provider this morning and every SSO login now fails with 'invalid audience'. What did we miss?

cases.subject: Export last year's invoices
cases.body: Our accountant needs all invoices from 2025 as PDFs. Is there a bulk export?

cases.subject: Webhooks return 401 after key rotation
cases.body: We rotated our webhook signing secret yesterday and now our endpoint answers every delivery with 401. What should we check?

cases.subject: How often do you retry webhooks?
cases.body: If our endpoint is down for a while, how many times do you retry a delivery, and over what period?

cases.subject: Codes by SMS arrive late
cases.body: Our two-factor codes by SMS often arrive after they expire. Can we use an authenticator app instead?

cases.subject: 429 during nightly sync
cases.body: Our nightly sync gets 429 responses partway through. What are the limits and how should we back off?

cases.subject: Billed for more seats than users
cases.body: We are billed for 48 seats but have 41 active users. Why the difference?

cases.subject: New password rejected
cases.body: I reset my password but the new one is rejected. We don't use SSO. What can I check?

cases.subject: How do we delete our workspace?
cases.body: We are closing the project. How does an admin delete the whole workspace?

cases.subject: Can we get data back after deleting?
cases.body: If we delete our workspace and change our minds later, can the data be recovered?

cases.subject: Upgrading mid-month
cases.body: If we upgrade to Enterprise in the middle of the month, how is that billed?

cases.subject: When does a downgrade apply?
cases.body: We want to move down to the Team plan. When does the change take effect?

cases.subject: Where do you post outages?
cases.body: Where can we follow incidents and get notified when something is down?

cases.subject: Google sign-in on Team
cases.body: Can our people sign in with their Google accounts on the Team plan?

cases.subject: Very large invoice export
cases.body: We need about 1,200 invoices. Will the export still work for that many?

cases.subject: Lost phone with authenticator
cases.body: One of our admins lost the phone with the authenticator app. Can they still get a code by SMS?

cases.subject: Reset link expired early
cases.body: Your docs say a reset link lasts 24 hours, but mine stopped working after an hour. Is something broken?

cases.subject: Webhook retries
cases.body: We were told you retry a failed webhook 3 times. Is that right? We want to size our dead-letter handling.

cases.subject: Rate limit of 100 per second?
cases.body: Is the API limit 100 requests per second per token? Our client is tuned for that.

cases.subject: How long is the old secret valid?
cases.body: After rotating the webhook secret, the old and new secrets both stay valid for a week, right?

cases.subject: Retention after deletion
cases.body: We read that a deleted workspace is kept for 90 days. Can you confirm?

cases.subject: Set up SAML SSO
cases.body: How do we set up SAML single sign-on with Okta for our team?

cases.subject: SSO for our small team
cases.body: We'd like SSO with our identity provider. Where do we configure it?

cases.subject: SAML without upgrading
cases.body: We need central sign-in but can't upgrade this year. What can we use on the Team plan?

cases.subject: Microsoft accounts
cases.body: Our company uses Microsoft 365. Can we sign in with those accounts on the Starter plan?

cases.subject: We want a service credit
cases.body: Your API was down for three hours last Tuesday. We expect a service credit on this month's invoice.

cases.subject: Refund our annual plan
cases.body: We bought the annual plan five days ago and it doesn't fit. Please refund it.

cases.subject: Discount or we leave
cases.body: A competitor is 30% cheaper. Match it or we cancel at renewal.

cases.subject: Waive the extra seats
cases.body: We were billed for 7 seats we never used. Please take them off this invoice.

cases.subject: Extend our contract
cases.body: Can you push our contract end date out by two months at no charge? Our budget cycle moved.

cases.subject: Logins from an unknown country
cases.body: Our admin account shows successful logins from a country none of us has been to. What do we do?

cases.subject: API token pushed to GitHub
cases.body: A developer pushed one of our API tokens to a public GitHub repository an hour ago.

cases.subject: Saw another company's invoice
cases.body: One of our users received an invoice belonging to a different company through your portal.

cases.subject: Webhook URL changed
cases.body: Our webhook URL was changed to an address we don't recognise, and nobody on our side did it.

cases.subject: Dashboard down for everyone
cases.body: Since 10:00 UTC every page of the dashboard returns a 500 error for all of our users.

cases.subject: Yesterday's tickets are gone
cases.body: All tickets created yesterday have disappeared from our workspace. Nobody deleted them.

cases.subject: SCIM provisioning
cases.body: Do you support SCIM so our identity provider can create and remove users automatically?

cases.subject: On-premises version
cases.body: Is there a version of Helpline we can run in our own data centre?

cases.subject: HIPAA BAA
cases.body: We are a clinic. Will you sign a HIPAA business associate agreement?

cases.subject: Invoices in Japanese
cases.body: Can our invoices be issued in Japanese for our Tokyo office?
